item: GPU molecular dynamics of the PCSK9-LDLR complex
why: requires a GPU node and OpenMM/GROMACS plus multi-microsecond sampling; no GPU is available in this environment, and a short run would not support the convergence or replica requirements the critique itself sets
what_stands_instead: the static contact analysis remains, flagged as static; it cannot report binding free energy, conformational stability or force-field sensitivity

item: 3D CFD and fluid-structure interaction of coronary plaque
why: needs OpenFOAM or SimVascular plus a meshed coronary geometry; neither the solver nor an imaging-derived geometry is available here
what_stands_instead: the 0D hoop-stress model, with its assumed 300 kPa rupture threshold now registered as HYPOTHETICAL rather than presented as a criterion

item: Bayesian posterior distributions for the cytokine rates
why: the audit shows 0 of 14 rates are jointly identifiable, so a posterior would report a prior with a decimal point
what_stands_instead: feasibility analysis, collinearity measurement and an explicit list of rates held fixed as assumptions
